'''John Robert Kline''' (December 7, 1891 – May 2, 1955)<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://personal.psu.edu/ecb5/EPHist/section-19.html|title=3.7 Profile: John Robert Kline (1891-1955)|website=EPADEL:A Semisesquicentennial History, 1926-2000|accessdate=April 28, 2023}}</ref> was an American mathematician and educator.

==Biography==
One of three children born to Henry K. Kline and Emma M. Kline, he was Professor of [[mathematics]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] from 1920 to 1955. A Ph.D. student of [[Robert Lee Moore]], he was a [[Guggenheim Fellow]] in 1925, later Chairman of the Department of Mathematics from 1933 to 1954, and [[Thomas A. Scott Professorship of Mathematics|Thomas A. Scott Professor of Mathematics]] from 1941 to 1955.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://math.temple.edu/~zit/Zitarelli/WP%20Rank%26File.pdf|title= RANK AND FILE AMERICAN MATHEMATICIANS |website=math.temple.edu |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20160306052035/https://math.temple.edu/~zit/Zitarelli/WP%20Rank%26File.pdf |access-date=2020-07-10|archive-date= 2016-03-06 }}</ref>

His doctoral students include [[Lida Barrett]], Donald Flanders, Joseph Harrison Kusner, [[Arthur Milgram]], [[Athanasios Papoulis]], [[Dudley Weldon Woodard]], [[Leo Zippin]],<ref>[http://legacyrlmoore.org/reference/fitzpatrick.html The Legacy of R. L. Moore, The Students of R. L. Moore — Ben Fitzpatrick, Jr.], legacyrlmoore.org; accessed July 9, 2020.</ref> and [[William Waldron Schieffelin Claytor]].<ref>[https://www.maa.org/programs-and-communities/outreach-initiatives/summa/summa-archival-record/william-claytor William W. Schieffelin Claytor] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191215192911/https://www.maa.org/programs-and-communities/outreach-initiatives/summa/summa-archival-record/william-claytor |date=2019-12-15 }} at the [[Mathematical Association of America]]</ref>

Kline was elected to the [[American Philosophical Society]] in 1941.<ref>{{Cite web |title=APS Member History |url=https://search.amphilsoc.org/memhist/search?creator=John+R.+Kline&title=&subject=&subdiv=&mem=&year=&year-max=&dead=&keyword=&smode=advanced |access-date=2023-04-28 |website=search.amphilsoc.org}}</ref>
